transcript_tail.text:
Here's the full recollection of everything we discussed across the four prior sessions, organized by topic.

## Career direction — role archetypes considered
- **Stay in management (EM/Director/Head of Eng)** — on the table, rejected
- **Pure heads-down IC (Senior/Staff/Principal)** — on the table, rejected
- **Hybrid tech-lead / staff+ with leadership** — **selected** (later refined: 2–4 reports, ~70% IC / 30% leverage)
- **Founder / contractor** — rejected for now
- Within the selected lane, four concrete sub-paths were named: **(1) Staff/Founding Eng at AI startups Series A–C** (Anthropic, OpenAI, Sierra, Decagon, Cresta, Harvey, Hebbia), **(2) Forward-Deployed Engineer** (Anthropic, OpenAI, Palantir, Sierra), **(3) Applied AI inside mature remote-friendly cos** (Stripe, Shopify, Vercel, Cloudflare, GitLab — later deprioritized once "no big-co" was set), **(4) Fractional / advisory / AI consulting**.

## Job-search tooling alternatives
- **Data source:** Adzuna (selected) · LinkedIn official API (rejected — gated) · LinkedIn scraping (rejected — ToS) · JSearch via RapidAPI (rejected — tight free tier, middleman) · separate opt-in LinkedIn browser tool (shelved).
- **Form factor:** Claude Code skill (selected) · MCP server (rejected — single-user) · plain CLI (rejected — kills the interview workflow).
- **Deps:** stdlib `urllib` only (selected) vs `requests`/`httpx`/`pydantic` (rejected — friction).

## AI portfolio / pet-project ideas
- Generic projects originally proposed and *superseded* once FamilyFund + dstrader surfaced: agentic merchant resolver · on-device LLM mobile app · NL→SQL agent over EDGAR · fraud-investigation co-pilot.
- **AI stock picker** (your first instinct) — rejected hard (yellow flag for hiring).
- **Position Thesis Agent on dstrader/FamilyFund** — selected flagship. Four-step MVP: schema (`position_theses`, `position_thesis_history`, `thesis_evidence`) → SEC-EDGAR-backed thesis generator → scheduled drift detector wired into the existing daily email → eval harness on ~50 labeled filings.
- **FamilyFund Goal-Coaching agent** — kept as v2.
- **Skipped:** receipt OCR (no doc layer), portfolio chatbot (lowest signal), anything touching the rebalance logic.

## Target companies / stages
- Stage band: **seed → Series B**. Big-co/FAANG: explicitly off.
- Named A–C AI startups + Forward-Deployed shops above; mature remote cos deprioritized.

## Pre-vetted talent marketplaces (session 3)
- **Worth your time:** A.Team (best fit) · Braintrust · Gun.io.
- **Profile, low urgency:** Arc.dev · Hired · Wellfound (AngelList).
- **Skip:** Toptal (vetting gauntlet) · Triplebyte (defunct since Karat 2023) · CodeSignal GCA / HackerRank certs.
- Mentioned in passing: Terminal.io, Andela, Lemon.io, Otta, YC Work at a Startup.

## Search filters
- Bias titles to: staff engineer, tech lead, founding engineer, lead engineer, principal (small co).
- Skip: EM, director, VP. Comp/location/sponsorship: never pinned.

## Positioning / signal-building
- Don't apply yet — build **2 real LLM/agent projects with evals** + **2 short posts** first.
- Resume rewrite for startup-tech-lead positioning (cut EM language, surface IC depth).
- LinkedIn pass alongside.
- One-page "first 90 days" doc brought unprompted to final rounds — "near cheat-code at this level."

## Four-week interview prep ramp (session 4)
- **Week 0:** target list via skill, resume/LinkedIn rewrite, 8–10 stories → 5–6 STAR drafts.
- **Week 1 technical:** 3× system design (startup-flavored), 2× live coding with mid-stream curveballs, 2× code-review of deliberately-flawed PRs.
- **Week 2 behavioral + product:** STAR drilling with pushback, player-coach scenarios, PM roleplay.
- **Week 3 company-specific + offer prep:** 3× first-90-days docs, equity literacy (409A, preferred-vs-common, refresh grants, acceleration, dilution), pipeline check.

## Pipeline tactics
- Run **8–12 loops in parallel** (senior closes in 2–4 weeks, serial = no leverage).
- Referrals beat cold apply ~5:1 — list 20 network people first.
- Skip for this archetype: org design / headcount / perf calibration framing (sounds big-co), and heavy distributed-systems theory (most Series A/B run monolith + Postgres).

---

## Gaps in current memory worth saving

Six topics came up but aren't captured in any of the six memory files:

1. **Named target-company universe** (the A–C AI startup list + Forward-Deployed shops)
2. **Marketplace verdicts** from session 3 (A.Team / Braintrust / Gun.io as keepers; Toptal/Triplebyte/CodeSignal as skips)
3. **The four-week interview prep ramp itself** — the write to file was blocked and never landed
4. **Position Thesis Agent MVP spec** (the four-step plan + the explicit "skip" list) — `user_pet_projects.md` only has the narrative
5. **Pipeline strategy** — 8–12 parallel loops, 5:1 referral rule, "build 2 projects + 2 posts before applying" sequencing
6. **`MEMORY.md` index is stale** — only lists 2 of the 6 actual memory files

Want me to write up any of these as memory files?

Yeah. Let's write up all of them. I also was working on the... on a portfolio prep. Like, I was working on on exposing... creating a... my my website with some of my portfolio of this, the and the family fund projects.
Writing up all six gaps plus a portfolio-website memory now, then I'll ask a couple of detail questions on the website.
Let me read the actual MEMORY.md location before updating it — and adjust the link paths since MEMORY.md lives inside `memory/` next to the memory files.
The system loads `memory/MEMORY.md`, so paths should be relative to that file (no `memory/` prefix). Updating it now with the full 12-entry index.

All six new memory files written and the index in `memory/MEMORY.md` is now complete (12 entries).

A couple of housekeeping notes and then a question about the website:

1. **Stale duplicate index file.** There's a second `MEMORY.md` at `/Users/claudio1/.claude/projects/-Users-claudio1-dev-job-search/MEMORY.md` (the parent dir) that the system *doesn't* load — its index is out of date (only 4 of 12 entries, missing the skill + criteria + everything new). I left it alone to avoid deleting user files unprompted. Want me to delete it, or rewrite it to match?

2. **Portfolio website memory is intentionally thin.** I captured the framing constraint (research-agent narrative, no "AI stock picker" drift) but flagged URL/stack/status as TBD. Quick questions to flesh it out:
